2105-3603-7297-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-7297-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-7297-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

151-5089-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-5089-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5089-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

1251-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

529-4068-7690-8181--165.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
529-4068-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2438-4871-8168.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

3259-4359-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4359-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Garna can be omitted.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-5226-6972.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2438-2946-3220-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2438-2946-3220-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-1376-5223.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-5223.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2557-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

5261-6587-6588-7638.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1394-2034-2060-2445-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Branching Evolution.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Branching Evolution.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: was foretold on a previous turn

4629-6999-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
4629-6999-7124.description:
Cast Sozin's Comet from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}, giving each creature you control firebending 5 until end of turn.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker. Its firebending ability triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
4629-6999-7124.notes: If desired, you can use the remaining {R} to activate Pyrohemia more times and stack combat phases.

3110-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3110-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

955-4644-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1247-3918-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
1247-3918-6893.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Eternity Elevator's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

565-1858-6632--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-6632--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

678-5670-6539.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6539.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Willow Geist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Willow Geist by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2438-4558-5913.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
2091-2438-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

1461-2811-4050-4078.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1461-2811-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Wurmcoil Engine enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Elas il-Kor's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
When the Wurms enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurms, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1110-1981-3629.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
1110-1981-3629.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to you equal to the creature's power, with you being unable to lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Darien triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the damage dealt to you.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to you, with you being unable to lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Repeat from step 3.

567-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1872-3003-4311-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1872-3003-4311-5220.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Composite Golem dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Composite Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Composite Golem from the top of your library by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.

969-2232-4103-4747.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Yidaro enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least eight {R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Alena from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Yidaro ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Alena by paying {4}{R}.
Alena enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand.
 Repeat.

1558-2740-4231-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1374-1636-1785.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana.
1374-1636-1785.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing any other nontoken Knight that can be cast using only black mana, adding an amount of {B} equal to that creature's mana value.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
The Knight enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2655-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
2655-5195.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers for each copy, creating a Treasure token each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 7.

499-3179-3676-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {G}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
